tech.name: Microsoft Autopilot (in the Copilot app; previously Scout)
tech.released: introduced 2026-09-25; rolling out to Frontier customers from 2026-11-17 (Ignite)
tech.status: rolling out in the Frontier program (needs Microsoft Copilot, Agent 365, usage-based billing); Entra Agent ID support in preview
tech.one_line: An always-on personal agent you give a name and a goal; it keeps the work moving across Teams, Outlook, chats and documents without waiting for a prompt, with its own Entra Agent ID and a named manager, and it can check with you before key actions.

predecessor.name: Copilot Chat: quick answers and drafts, one prompt at a time; the next step waits for your next prompt (the scene and counted example are the episode's own)

claims.text: Autopilot began rolling out to Frontier customers on Nov 17, 2026 (Ignite)
Autopilot was introduced Sep 25, 2026, previously called Scout; private preview at the end of September
A trusted autonomous agent that is personal to you, always on, and working for you
Shows up in Teams, Outlook, chats, channels and documents; you can @mention it like a colleague
Watches Teams channels, follows up on emails, runs recurring work and manages a project without waiting for a prompt
Microsoft's example: sets up and manages a full supplier review (schedule, workback plan, prep, meetings, follow-ups, reaching out to stakeholders)
Each Autopilot has its own Microsoft Entra Agent ID and a named manager; IT can scope its access and block it anytime; actions logged under its own name
Entra Agent ID support for Autopilot is in preview
You decide what work Autopilot takes on and it can check with you before key actions
Keeps moving your work forward 24x7 (CEO keynote)
Give it a name, a role and a goal, and it goes to work, without waiting for a prompt; keeps working while you sleep
Copilot Chat is for quick answers and drafts; Cowork does one task end to end when you ask; Autopilot keeps going in the background without being asked
Rolling out in the Frontier program for customers with Microsoft Copilot, Agent 365 and a usage-based billing policy; usage-based billing with Copilot Credits; final pricing before GA
Gets oriented on the last 30 days of email, meetings, chats and files you already have access to, without sending or changing anything
Our example (invented): a 2-week supplier review with 10 follow-ups = 10 prompts in Copilot Chat vs 1 goal for Autopilot, with 2 checks you approve
